practical: Activity: Identification of secondary control surfaces on training aircraft. Safety: Ensure aircraft is chocked and engines off. Supervision: Instructor direct observation.
intro_questions: What are the three primary flight controls?

topics: Slats and leading edge devices function
development.content:
Flaps types and deployment mechanisms
Slats and leading edge devices function
Spoilers and speed brake operation

Thrust reverser operational principles
Types of thrust reverser systems
Safety interlocks and indications

Wheel braking system components
Anti-skid system functionality
Performance impact of braking

summary_questions: Explain how flaps affect lift and drag coefficients.
Describe the primary safety concern with thrust reversers.
Why is the anti-skid system critical during landing?
home_assignment_question: Research the specific balancing techniques used for flight control surfaces to prevent flutter, as this will be covered in the next lesson.
